info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Securities Financing API
info.description: The Securities Financing API allows users to access detailed information regarding securities financing transactions. This endpoint provides critical insights into various financing operations, enabling stakeholders like treasury departments and financial analysts to monitor and analyze their securities inventory efficiently. Typical use cases include retrieving current financing rates, terms, and associated collateral details. By enabling seamless access to these data points, the API supports informed decision-making and enhances risk management capabilities.
